reason: The idea is useful, but ArmorHub is brand new and only has partners in Riyadh and Cairo, so I cannot yet see anyone who has done a job for me. I will not hand over money for paint film on an M4 to a company I have never heard of before I see real reviews and a partner I can check.
objection: Who is actually going to put this film on my car, and will they come to my area at a time I choose? If the money is held and the warranty sits in an app, I still need the installer to be real and to do the work properly.
would_change_my_mind: A verified partner near me with a track record, a visit at a time I pick, and a written warranty I can check in the app before I pay.
